_meta.note: Shared by the Today, Enrol and Patient pages. Plain words; the never-on-screen list is in docs/DESIGN.md.

clinic.title: Today
clinic.givenFor: Mark dose {dose} given for register no. {no}

empty.dueDone: Every dose due today is marked given.
empty.next: No one is due in the next 2 days.
empty.waiting: No one is waiting for a first call.

offline.title: Lists come back when the server answers.

vaccine.title: Vaccine
vaccine.inLine: Reminders now give the dose date and say come to the clinic.
vaccine.outLine: Out {since}. Reminders now say: call the clinic first.
vaccine.outNoTime: Out. Reminders now say: call the clinic first.
vaccine.explain: Switch to Out when the clinic has no vaccine. Reminder calls then ask patients to call the clinic first. Switch back to In stock when it arrives.
vaccine.confirmBody: Reminder calls will tell patients to call the clinic first.

callbacks.title: Call-back requests ({count})
callbacks.explain: Phone them, then press Done. If you could not reach them, press Couldn't reach. The call-back never shows what the patient said on the call.
callbacks.ask: The ABC team asked the clinic to phone this patient.
callbacks.shown: Number shown for {s} seconds. Each look is logged.

unlinked.title: Missed calls to link ({count})
unlinked.explain: Someone gave a missed call and no patient is linked to the number yet. Link it to the patient who is waiting for the first call. Numbers that stay unlinked are deleted automatically.

link.title: Link to a patient
link.pick: Missed call {when}, {phone}. Tap the patient who gave it.
link.none: No patient is waiting for a first call. Enrol the patient first, then link the call.
